name: Trackers
author: Project Σ
description: Keeps track of what a chat should: a scene, a cast, an inventory, relationships, or anything you define. Your own model updates each tracker after every reply, and the chat's prompt carries it, as of the turn the reply follows. Switch one on for a chat from the Trackers window in the conversation. Ships off; switch it on to use it. Inspired by kaldigo's Tracker for SillyTavern, with thanks to its author.
